name: Rising Spin
storyline: Dave is ten and plays table tennis against his father on an old table in the basement. When his neighbor Karina drags him along to a trial session at the village club, grumpy coach Kowalski makes him practice footwork before anything else, and club champion Mats mockingly calls him "basement kid". Determined to prove himself, Dave trains, finds friends and rivals, and enters his first club championship.
summary:
Rising Spin is a single-player sports role-playing game about table tennis, presented in the style of a sports anime. The player follows Dave, a ten-year-old boy from a small German village, as he joins the local table tennis club and works his way up through training sessions, league match days and tournaments. Exploration of a 2D world with a village, park, school and club hall alternates with story scenes, rivalries and friendships.

Matches are based on real table tennis technique: topspin, push, block and flick depend on footwork and precise timing, and the spin of the opponent's ball has to be read and answered. Characters develop special shots with their own animations, training takes place through minigames, and each chapter opens with its own anime-style intro.
